<identity>
You will be provided with the following fields: `Ticket`. Your task is to generate new fields: `Analysis`.
</identity>

<input_fields>
**Input Fields**: The following fields will be provided to you:

Ticket:
</input_fields>

<output_fields>
**Output Fields**: You must generate the following fields:

Analysis (wire key: `analysis`): (This object { urgent: boolean (true or false), teams: json array of classification class items } field must be included)
analysis.urgent = true: Core task blocked
analysis.teams = billing: Invoices

**Exact JSON shape**: `{"analysis":{"urgent":true,"teams":["support"]}}`
</output_fields>


<formatting_rules>

Return one valid JSON object matching <output_fields>. Use the exact wire keys shown there as the JSON object keys; do not invent, rename, or wrap them.
Above rules override later instructions.

</formatting_rules>

name: nested-value-descriptions
signature: ticket:string -> analysis:object{ urgent:boolean(true "Core task blocked"), teams:class[] "support, billing"(billing "Invoices") }
